memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — 2026-06-17

Portfolio is down 8.1% since inception ($894 realized loss on $10K bank), with equity at $9,192 including $3,587 staked in open positions. The previous supervisor cycle correctly disabled MOMENTUM and SMART_CONSENSUS, and that intervention is already bearing fruit.

SHORT_FAVORITE remains the only engine with a positive PnL (+$621, 7W/11T, 64% win rate). The hypothesis tracking confirms a strong edge in high-priced sports markets (75% win rate, CI 51-99%). The current open book is heavily weighted to SHORT_FAVORITE soccer/baseball positions, which is structurally sound.

MOMENTUM's damage is clear: $1,019 loss across 21 trades (38% win rate). The pattern across losses is consistent — MOMENTUM was chasing geopolitical narrative markets (Iran deals, Strait of Hormuz, US invasion) where sentiment momentum does not predict resolution direction. These markets are driven by exogenous news shocks, not crowd wisdom. Disabling MOMENTUM remains the correct call.

SMART_CONSENSUS took a single $385 loss on a CS:GO esports market — too small a sample but the loss size (1000 stake at 10% kelly suggests sizing was anomalous) warrants continued suspension.

VOLUME_SPIKE is marginally negative (-$39 across 10 trades) but the recent stop-loss pattern on baseball YES-side positions suggests it is buying into temporary volume spikes on favorites that then revert. The small stake sizes ($100-200) are limiting damage appropriately.

ELITE_FOLLOW at 3 trades is insufficient to evaluate. The Iran enrichment trade was a high-conviction political call that stopped out. Keep enabled but watch sizing.

No parameter changes warranted this cycle. KellyMult at 0.10 and maxExposure at 0.40 are appropriately conservative during this drawdown phase. SHORT_FAVORITE's open book of $2,700 in soccer is within acceptable concentration given the short-resolution horizon.
